title: Every !important inline style set in a show path must have a matching remove in the hide path
trigger: Show/apply path sets inline styles with !important to override site CSS, and a hide/restore path must return the element to its prior state
principle: !important inline styles survive across state transitions — the browser does not auto-clean them. Every setProperty(prop, value, 'important') in a show/apply path MUST have a corresponding removeProperty(prop) (or explicit reset) in the hide/restore path. If a MutationObserver guard re-applies the styles, stop the observer BEFORE removing styles, otherwise it re-applies them within milliseconds.

cases.context: Show path centers a video inside a 70% wrapper with !important transform + object-fit; hide path removes most props but forgets transform → after open→close the video jumps off-screen by -50% of its own size
Floating panel sets body max-height: 400px (correct for floating mode); switching to docked mode does not reset it → cue list capped at 400px instead of filling the docked panel

applyFor: Content script toggle cycles (show/hide panel, overlay, dock) using !important to override site CSS
React imperative DOM mutation (useState + ref.style.setProperty) with show/hide transitions
Any show/hide pattern using !important to override host page CSS
MutationObserver guard patterns that re-apply styles — stop observer before removing styles
Mode transitions (floating ↔ docked, overlay ↔ inline) where mode-specific inline styles must be reset
